reason: Automates Git commit attribution by temporarily installing a prepare-commit-msg hook that adds model and dsh trailers, while preserving existing hooks and restoring them after the session.

summaries.zh: 在智能体提交代码时自动通过 Git 钩子添加模型署名和 dsh 生成标记，并在会话结束后恢复原有钩子。
summaries.en: Automatically adds model attribution and dsh generation trailers to agent-created Git commits through a temporary hook that restores existing hooks when the session ends.

capabilities: Installs and removes a prepare-commit-msg Git hook during agent sessions
Adds Co-Authored-By and Generated-By trailers to Git commits
Backs up, chains, and restores existing repository hooks
May request a sandbox permission upgrade when a commit is blocked in read-only mode
